title: private-deployment-lyra-weekly-sync-2026-10-05
body:
Weekly sync prep / notes — Lyra private deployment (VPC/on-prem) — 2026-10-05

Attendees (planned): Miguel Alvarez (owner), Claire Zhang (SRE), Ethan Brooks (Solutions Eng), Sara Lee (Customer IT lead, Lyra), Tom Hwang (Network), + optional: Laura Park (Security)

Agenda:
- Quick status updates (10m)
- Blockers & escalation items (10m)
- Upcoming milestones: rack install, network validation, KMS integration (10m)
- Rollout plan for staging -> prod and rollback criteria (10m)
- Action items & owners (5m)

TL;DR (one-liner): Hardware on-site next week; we need final Firewall rules + BGP peer confirmation by Wed to avoid rack access delays. KMS onboarding blocked by Lyra compliance signoff (legal).

Progress since last sync:
- Image build for 1.3.0 passed internal smoke tests (CI pipeline) — PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/78
- Rack units 12-16 reserved at datacenter, ETA delivery 2026-10-07 (confirmed by DC ops)
- VPC subnet templates prepared and shared with Lyra (CLA draft), waiting on final CIDR approval from Lyra IT
- Basic connectivity test to staging env successful from Redwood staging (see PDLYRA-142)

Milestones (near-term):
- 2026-10-07: Hardware delivery to DC (owner: Lyra DC onsite / DC ops)
- 2026-10-08: Rack & power install window (owner: DC ops + Tom Hwang)
- 2026-10-09: Cable handoff / cross-connect validation (owner: Tom Hwang)
- 2026-10-10: Network ACL + Firewall rules finalization and BGP peer test (owner: Lyra IT / Sara Lee)
- 2026-10-11: KMS/HSM onboarding dry-run in staging (owner: Claire Zhang + Lyra security)
- 2026-10-13: First full-stack deploy to Lyra staging cluster (owner: Miguel Alvarez)

Current blockers / risk items:
1) Firewall / cross-connect rules outstanding — Lyra IT has draft rules but needs to confirm port ranges for agent updates and KV cache sync (risk: rack install delay). Owner: Sara Lee. Ask: final list + CIDR by 2026-10-07 EOD.
2) KMS legal/compliance signoff — Lyra legal still reviewing the MSA addendum for KMS key material flow. Blocks: production KMS integration and HSM proofs. Owner: Lyra legal (cc: Laura Park). Escalation: If no signoff by 2026-10-08, open exec sync.
3) BGP peer IPs not finalized — DC needs primary/standby IPs, Lyra to confirm ASN and peer IPs. Owner: Tom Hwang + Sara Lee. Due: 2026-10-06 to keep 10/8 window.
4) Staging smoke failure on nightly long-seq tests — intermittent OOM observed on 64k tokens scenario; mitigation: reduce default max_window for canary until kernel patch applied. Owner: Claire Zhang. Temporary workaround in PDLYRA-145.

Notes / things to call out in the meeting:
- Confirm Lyra resource tagging scheme for billing attribution (required for reserved capacity accounting).
- Agree on observability retention: Lyra asked for 90-day traces; platform currently supports 30-day standard. Need PO decision—tag as action.
- Can we enable prefix KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start latency for first 500k requests? Need to check memory impact on on-prem nodes.

Action items (explicit):
- Sara Lee: Finalize Firewall rules + CIDR + BGP ASN + peer IPs and upload to ticket PDLYRA-142 by 2026-10-06. (high)
- Tom Hwang: Coordinate DC cross-connect window and confirm cable mapping. Provide rack photos after install. Due 2026-10-08. (medium)
- Claire Zhang: Apply kernel memory patch to staging canary and rerun long-seq smoke tests; report results in thread. Due 2026-10-06. (high)
- Miguel Alvarez: Prepare staging deployment runbook (checklist for KMS flow, rollback steps, canary threshold). Share draft before EOD 2026-10-09. (high)
- Laura Park: Follow up with Lyra legal for KMS addendum status and share expected signoff ETA. Due 2026-10-07. (high)
- Ethan Brooks: Draft observability retention options and cost delta (30d -> 90d) and circulate for decision. Due 2026-10-09. (medium)

Follow-ups / escalation plan:
- If KMS signoff not received by 2026-10-08, escalate to Ryan (Director, Solutions) and Lyra exec sponsor for a decision path (temp tokenization alternative or limited HSM demo).
- If firewall/CIDR not provided by 2026-10-07, request DC to hold install until rules confirmed — contingency: partial install with offline power verify but no network activation.

Meeting prep checklist for Miguel (today):
- Pull PDLYRA-142 & PDLYRA-145 tickets and add test logs to the doc.
- Confirm attendee list and ping Lyra IT to ensure Sara + network engineer on call.
- Prepare brief slide (1-2 slides) summarizing blockers + decisions needed.

Next sync: 2026-10-12 (same time). If urgent, ad-hoc call will be scheduled mid-week.

Quick links (for meeting):
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PDLYRA-142
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PD/Lyra+Private+Deployment+Runbook
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/78

Notes to self: keep the meeting tight (30m). Focus on decisions not updates — escalate legal/exec early.

End of notes.
